understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Kräfte auf denselben Körper haben eine gemeinsame Resultierende; vorhandene Kräfte können sich aufheben.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Forces on one body share a resultant; forces that still act can cancel.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Pairwise internal forces cancel out of the system balance; external impulse changes total momentum.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Leitet die Bilanz her und unterscheidet Endgleichheit von fortlaufender Konstanz.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Derives the balance and distinguishes equal endpoints from continuous constancy.

understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Transfers to a narrower system and to opposing impulses separated in time.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: At a position, the field is force per mass and its direction is independent of the test mass.

understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Corrects field lines and keeps the field arrow fixed for m and 3m at the same position.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: In the nearly stationary center-of-momentum frame, two photons have almost opposite momenta and about 511 keV each.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Bilanziert Energie und Impuls und erklärt die Rolle der beiden Detektionen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Balances energy and momentum and explains the role of the two detections.

understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Transfer includes a moving pair and the bounded role of coincidence signals.
